value.rationale: For fixed two deletions over the ternary alphabet, length five is the first length after the classical length-four \(t=n-2\) design regime and the first where the optimum exceeds \(3\). The general finite upper bound \(14\) leaves a substantial gap; the exact value \(6\) and full equality census close that natural small-parameter case and supply reproducible extremal benchmark data.
